description: Writes a reply to a message and saves it to Drafts, correctly threaded (Re: subject, quoted original, reply headers). Nothing is sent.

account.description: Which mailbox to use, by its name or email address. Configured: none configured yet. Required when more than one is set up.

body.description: Your reply, as plain text. The original message is quoted underneath automatically.

folder.description: Folder to look in. Defaults to the inbox. Accepts "inbox", "sent", "drafts", "trash", "spam", "archive" or an exact folder name from list_folders.

id.description: Id of the message being replied to.

reply_all.description: Also include everyone else who was on the original email.

name: draft_reply
title: Draft a reply
